args.title: Handle quoted CSV headers correctly in parseStatement
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Fix parseStatement to properly split the header line using splitFields instead of splitting on commas directly, to correctly handle CSV headers with quoted column names. This fixes the error where files with quoted headers such as "date","amount","description" cause a malformed row error at the first data row.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The error "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" occurs because the header line is split on commas without accounting for quoted fields. The file src/ingest/parser.ts handles the parsing and has a function splitFields for correctly splitting CSV lines with quoted fields. The code currently splits the header with simple String.split, causing quoted headers to be read incorrectly. Updating parseStatement to split the header line using splitFields will fix this issue for files with quoted headers like "date","amount","description".
